description.narrative: The project catalyzes industrial decarbonization in South Africa by supporting a shift to near-zero emission steel production through innovative technologies and an enabling policy framework. The project's impact is the transformation and decarbonization of South Africa’s steel industry and other industrial sectors. Key outcomes include significantly reduced GHG emissions, a policy landscape enabling investment in industrial decarbonization solutions, mobilization of private and public finance, adoption of near-zero technology, creation of new green jobs, and improved gender equality and social inclusion. These outcomes will be achieved through outputs such as a replicable financial mechanism, enabling policy recommendations, innovative technology pilots, and enhanced technical and institutional capacity across the industry and finance and public sectors.
